name: io.github.manikumarkv/trueicon
title: TrueIcon
description: Lets AI coding assistants search the icon packages actually installed in your project.

environmentVariables.name: TRUEICON_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the project whose icon packages to search. Defaults to the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: TRUEICON_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the downloaded icon package cache. Defaults to ~/.trueicon/cache.
